readings: For each orders.orderbase value, including NULL as its own channel, consider every orderexecutions row whose ordersmark matches an orders.recordvault. Report the average of non-NULL fillcount values across those execution rows, the count of all matched execution rows, and that count divided by the total count of matched execution rows across all channels. Do not round.

For each orders.orderbase value, including NULL as its own channel, consider each order with at least one orderexecutions row whose ordersmark matches its recordvault. For each such order, sum its non-NULL fillcount values to get its filled quantity. Report the average of those order-level filled quantities, excluding orders for which every fillcount is NULL; the count of matched orders; and that count divided by the total count of matched orders across all channels. Do not round.
queries:
SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fillcount,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction
FROM orders AS o
JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase

WITH matched_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.orderspivot,
        o.orderbase,
        SUM(e.fillcount) AS filled_quantity
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN orderexecutions AS e
        ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.orderbase
)
SELECT
    orderbase,
    AVG(filled_quantity) AS average_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS matched_order_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS matched_order_share
FROM matched_orders
GROUP BY orderbase
